purpose: Teach: 総体/元祖/置き場/アウトソーシング/空調/積立/延べ/一様

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪総体の傾向を分析されますね
lines.en: The police analyze trends across all types of crime, don't they?
lines.style: Conversational, slightly formal. Soft upward lift at the end—genuine inquiry, not challenging. Respectful tone, like someone genuinely interested in understanding police work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、元祖の防犯活動を継承されてますね
lines.en: The police have carried on the founding crime prevention work, haven't they?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment. Nodding pace. The tone of someone recognizing continuity and tradition. Steady, affirming—not questioning.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、押収品の置き場を厳しく管理されますね
lines.en: The police manage the storage of seized items very carefully, don't they?
lines.style: Observant, almost impressed. Light weight on 'carefully'—noting the discipline involved. Steady pace. The tone of someone who notices the unglamorous rigor behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、業務のアウトソーシングは慎重に検討されますね
lines.en: The police weigh outsourcing decisions very carefully, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful nod in the voice. Slower pace on 'carefully'—respect for deliberation. Understands the stakes. Not fast, not rushed. Recognition of prudent judgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署の空調も省エネ化されますね
lines.en: The police station energy-efficient systems show commitment to sustainability, don't they?
lines.style: Light observation, almost wry but not unkind. Slight smile in the voice. The tone of noticing practical, ordinary diligence. Not mocking—amused at the thoroughness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、退職積立の制度をご説明されますね
lines.en: The police explain the retirement pension system clearly, don't they?
lines.style: Respectful inquiry. Steady, even pace. The tone of someone asking about institutional clarity and structure. Not probing—just genuinely wanting to understand how it works.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、延べ検挙数を市民に公表されますね
lines.en: The police report total arrest numbers to the public, don't they?
lines.style: Affirming observation. Warm tone—recognizing transparency. Steady pace. The rhythm of someone noting accountability and public trust. Not suspicious, but noting it matters.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、市民に一様な対応をされますね
lines.en: The police treat all citizens fairly and consistently, don't they?
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Slightly slower, more intimate pace. The tone deepens—this one matters. Eye-level sincerity. Not challenging, but grounded. Close.
